scenarios.name: Council of Elrond — The Fellowship is Formed
scenarios.description: The great council held at Rivendell to decide the fate of the One Ring. Representatives of all Free Peoples gather to form the Fellowship of the Ring. A diplomatic and strategic scenario where players must negotiate the fate of the Ring.
scenarios.map: Rivendell system — hidden sanctuary with spatial distortions

objective.free_peoples: Form the Fellowship of the Ring and safely escort the Ring-bearer out of Rivendell. The Fellowship must include representatives from at least 4 races.
objective.forces_of_darkness: Disrupt the council, corrupt a council member with the Ring, or prevent the Fellowship from forming.

free_peoples_forces: Representatives: Aragorn, Legolas, Gimli, Boromir, Frodo, Sam, Merry, Pippin
forces_of_darkness_influence: Sauron's Eye (surveillance — can observe the council)
Nazgûl approaching (threat timer — 6 rounds before they arrive)

special_rules: The Ring temptation mechanic: each council member must resist the Ring's allure
Gandalf's warning about the Palantíri provides intelligence
The Nazgûl approach — if they arrive before the Fellowship departs, the scenario fails
Gollum is captured and provides information about Mordor

victory_conditions.free_peoples: Fellowship of 9 members departs Rivendell safely
victory_conditions.forces_of_darkness: Fellowship fails to form OR the Ring-bearer is corrupted

scenarios.name: Battle of the Hornburg (Helm's Deep)
scenarios.description: The greatest battle of Rohan. Saruman's forces — orcs, Uruk-hai, and Wargs — attack the impregnable fortress of Helm's Deep. The Riders of Rohan must hold out until reinforcements arrive.
scenarios.map: Helm's Deep fortress station — Deeping Wall, Hornburg, and the caves

objective.rohan: Defend Helm's Deep for 6 rounds until Éomer's reinforcements arrive. Survive the assault.
objective.isengard: Breach the Deeping Wall and capture the Hornburg before reinforcements arrive.

rohan_forces: Women and children of the Deeping Coves (civilian tokens)

special_rules: The Deeping Wall provides heavy cover to defenders
Archers' Notch gives elven archers (if present) elevated firing positions
Éomer's riders arrive at round 6 from the rear
Avalanche: at round 5, Gandalf triggers an avalanche that destroys units on the cliffs
Saruman's flame-throwers can bypass cover
Civilian tokens must be protected; if captured, Rohan suffers morale penalties

victory_conditions.rohan: Survive 6 rounds with the Hornburg intact
victory_conditions.isengard: Capture the Hornburg OR eliminate King Théoden before round 6

scenarios.name: Battle of the Pelennor Fields
scenarios.description: The largest battle in the War of the Ring. Mordor's forces besiege Minas Tirith, but the Riders of Rohan arrive at dawn. The Witch-king falls, and the tide turns.
scenarios.map: Pelennor Fields — the plains before Minas Tirith fortress station

objective.free_peoples: Defend Minas Tirith and destroy the enemy forces. Kill the Witch-king.
objective.mordor: Breach the gates of Minas Tirith and capture the White Tower.

free_peoples_forces: Aragorn (commander — arrives with Reinforcements at round 3)
Riders of Rohan: 6 units (arrive at dawn, round 2)
Reinforcements of the Argonath (arrive at round 4)
mordor_forces: Witch-king of Angmar on Fell Beast (air unit)

special_rules: Dawn: at round 2, the Riders of Rohan arrive with a shock charge
The Witch-king can be attacked from the air (Fell Beast) and ground
Éowyn's disguise: she is hidden until she reveals herself
'Not by the hand of man': the Witch-king can only be killed by a non-man (Éowyn + Merry)
Aragorn's King's Call: Gondor soldiers on the walls fire arrows, pinning enemy forces
The Black Gate feint: Aragorn's approach draws forces away from the Pelennor
Mûmakil can crush the gates but are vulnerable to cavalry

victory_conditions.free_peoples: Destroy all enemy forces OR kill the Witch-king and hold Minas Tirith
victory_conditions.mordor: Breach the gates of Minas Tirith OR kill Faramir and Gandalf

scenarios.name: The Journey to Mount Doom
scenarios.description: Frodo and Sam journey through Mordor to destroy the One Ring in the fires of Mount Doom. A stealth and survival scenario where the Ring-bearer must avoid detection while crossing enemy territory.
scenarios.map: Mordor system — from the Emyn Muil to Orodruin (Mount Doom)

objective.frodo: Reach Mount Doom and destroy the Ring before the corruption track fills.
objective.mordor: Find and capture the Ring-bearer before they reach Mount Doom.

mordor_forces: The Eye of Sauron (surveillance — searches for the Ring)

special_rules: Corruption track: Frodo's corruption increases each round and after encounters
The Ring's weight: as corruption increases, Frodo's speed decreases
Gollum's split personality: can help (Sméagol) or betray (Gollum) at any time
Sting glows when Orcs are near — provides early warning but reveals position
Phial of Galadriel: can be used to repel Shelob and darkness
Shelob's Lair: a major encounter where Frodo is captured (Sam must rescue him)
The Black Gate: Frodo and Sam must find an alternate route (Cirith Ungol)
Mount Doom: the final destination — the Ring must be cast into the fires

victory_conditions.frodo: Reach Mount Doom and destroy the Ring (Gollum bites it from Frodo's finger and falls)
victory_conditions.mordor: Capture the Ring-bearer OR the corruption track fills (Frodo claims the Ring)

scenarios.name: The Ents March on Isengard
scenarios.description: Treebeard and the Ents, roused to anger by Saruman's destruction of Fangorn, march on Isengard to destroy the factories and free the river. A scenario where slow but unstoppable forces overwhelm industrial might.
scenarios.map: Isengard — the factory complex surrounding Orthanc Tower

objective.ents: Destroy Isengard's factories and dam the river. Orthanc cannot be destroyed but must be isolated.
objective.isengard: Defend the factories and prevent the Ents from breaching the walls.

isengard_forces: Saruman the White (in Orthanc — cannot directly fight but provides buffs)

special_rules: Ents are extremely slow (speed 1) but deal massive damage
Huorns swarm and entangle enemy units, reducing their speed to 0
The river: Ents can breach the dam, flooding Isengard and washing away units
Orthanc is indestructible — it cannot be damaged by any means
Saruman's Voice of Authority can stun Ent units if he gets a clear shot
Factory destruction: each destroyed factory reduces Isengard's production

victory_conditions.ents: Destroy all factories and flood Isengard
victory_conditions.isengard: Survive 6 rounds with at least 2 factories intact

scenarios.name: The Fall of the Fellowship at Moria
scenarios.description: The Fellowship is pursued by Orcs and takes the dangerous path through Moria. The Balrog awakens, and Gandalf falls with it into the abyss. A desperate defense scenario.
scenarios.map: Moria — the mines of Khazad-dûm, from the Carrock to the Khazad-dûm bridge

objective.fellowship: Escape Moria through the East Gate. Gandalf must hold the Bridge of Khazad-dûm long enough for the Fellowship to flee.
objective.moria: Kill as many Fellowship members as possible. The Balrog must reach Gandalf.

fellowship_forces: Gandalf the Grey (commander — must hold the bridge)
moria_forces: Balrog of Moria (arrives at wave 2 — demon of fire and shadow)

special_rules: Darkness: most units have reduced vision; only Gandalf's staff and Gimli's pick provide light
The Bridge of Khazad-dûm: Gandalf must stand on the bridge to hold it; the Balrog cannot cross until the bridge is broken
Gandalf's sacrifice: when Gandalf breaks the bridge, he falls with the Balrog and is removed from the game
Pippin's mistake: if Pippin is near the edge, he may fall and trigger the Balrog's arrival early
The Fellowship is broken: after Gandalf falls, the Fellowship disperses

victory_conditions.fellowship: At least 6 Fellowship members escape through the East Gate; Gandalf holds the bridge
victory_conditions.moria: Kill 4+ Fellowship members OR the Balrog reaches Gandalf before the bridge is broken

scenarios.name: The Scouring of the Shire
scenarios.era: Third Age, T.A. 3019 (after the Ring's destruction)
scenarios.description: After the destruction of the Ring, the returning hobbits find the Shire occupied by Saruman's forces. The hobbits must liberate their home in a final, unexpected battle.
scenarios.map: The Shire system — Bag End, the Bywater Inn, and the fields

objective.hobbits: Liberate the Shire and drive out Saruman's forces. The Battle of Bywater must be won.
objective.saruman: Hold the Shire and suppress the hobbit rebellion.

hobbit_forces: Samwise Gamgee (commander — Mayor of the Shire)
Hobbit Militia: 8 units (farmers with pitchforks and scythes)

special_rules: Hobbits are outnumbered but fight for their homes — +1 morale
The Battle of Bywater: hobbits use farm tools as weapons
Saruman is weakened — his Maiar power is reduced
Aragorn arrives after the battle to deal with Saruman
The Shire's healing: after victory, the Shire begins to recover

victory_conditions.hobbits: Defeat all enemy forces and liberate the Shire
victory_conditions.saruman: Hold the Shire for 6 rounds OR kill Samwise Gamgee

scenarios.name: The Last Alliance — Siege of Barad-dûr
scenarios.description: The Last Alliance of Elves and Men marches on Mordor to defeat Sauron. The greatest alliance in history, led by Elendil, Gil-galad, and Isildur. The siege of Barad-dûr and the duel of Elendil and Sauron.
scenarios.map: Mordor system — from Dagorlad to Barad-dûr

objective.alliance: Siege Barad-dûr and defeat Sauron. Isildur must cut the Ring from Sauron's hand.
objective.mordor: Defend Barad-dûr and destroy the Alliance. Prevent the Ring from being taken.

special_rules: Battle of Dagorlad: preliminary battle before the siege
Seven-year siege: the scenario can be played as a long campaign
Elendil falls: during the final assault, Elendil is killed
Gil-galad falls: the last Elven-king dies alongside Elendil
Isildur cuts the Ring: the Ring must be cut from Sauron's hand
Isildur's choice: he can spare the Ring (historical) or destroy it (alternate)

victory_conditions.alliance: Isildur cuts the Ring from Sauron's hand; Sauron's spirit is defeated
victory_conditions.mordor: Destroy the Alliance forces OR prevent the Ring from being taken

scenarios.name: The Downfall of Númenor (Akallabêth)
scenarios.description: Ar-Pharazôn sails against Valinor, and Eru Ilúvatar sinks Númenor into the sea. The greatest tragedy in the history of Arda — a once-great empire destroyed by its own hubris.
scenarios.map: The Arda galaxy — from Númenor to the shores of Valinor

objective.numenor: Reach the shores of Valinor and capture the Undying Lands. Immortality is the goal.
objective.valinor: Defend the Undying Lands. The Faithful must escape before the downfall.

numenor_forces: Númenórean Fleet: 15 units (the greatest fleet ever assembled)
Sauron (captured — advisor to Ar-Pharazôn, but secretly corrupting him)
valinor_forces: The Valar (cannot directly fight — they have withdrawn)
The Two Trees (sacred sites — cannot be damaged by conventional means)

special_rules: Sauron's corruption: Ar-Pharazôn's corruption increases each round
The Valar cannot fight — they have withdrawn from Arda
The Downfall: at round 6, Eru Ilúvatar sinks Númenor — all Númenórean units are destroyed
The Faithful: a small number of units can escape if they reach the edge of the map before the Downfall
The world is remade: after the Downfall, the Undying Lands are removed from the circles of the world

victory_conditions.numenor: Reach Valinor and capture the Two Trees (nearly impossible — the Downfall is inevitable)
victory_conditions.valinor: The Faithful escape; Númenor is destroyed by the Downfall

scenarios.name: The Battle of Bywater
scenarios.era: Third Age, T.A. 3019 (after the Ring's destruction)
scenarios.description: The hobbits of the Shire, armed with farm tools and courage, stand against Saruman's occupiers in the fields of Bywater. A David-vs-Goliath battle where the underdogs fight for their homes.
scenarios.map: The Shire system — the fields and roads around Bywater

objective.hobbits: Defeat the enemy forces in open battle and drive them from the Shire.
objective.saruman: Crush the hobbit rebellion and hold the field.

hobbit_forces: Hobbit Militia: 10 units (farmers with scythes, pitchforks, and slings)

special_rules: Hobbits fight for their homes — +2 morale; cannot retreat
Slingshot teams have long range but low damage
Merry's elven sword can cut through armor
Saruman's forces are outnumbered but better equipped
The battle is won when the enemy breaks and flees
After the battle, Aragorn arrives to deal with Saruman

victory_conditions.hobbits: Destroy or rout all enemy forces
victory_conditions.saruman: Eliminate Samwise Gamgee OR hold the field for 6 rounds

scenarios.name: The Battle of Dagorlad
scenarios.description: The preliminary battle before the Siege of Barad-dûr. The Last Alliance of Elves and Men crosses the plain of Dagorlad and faces Sauron's forces in open battle. The greatest clash of arms in the Second Age.
scenarios.map: Mordor system — the plain of Dagorlad, before the Black Gates

objective.alliance: Defeat Sauron's field army and force them behind the Black Gates.
objective.mordor: Destroy the Alliance on the plain and prevent them from reaching the gates.

special_rules: The Alliance is outnumbered but superior in quality
Númenórean armor is nearly impervious to orc weapons
Elven archers never miss — each shot kills
Sauron's forces fight with desperation — cannot retreat
The Black Gates provide heavy cover to Mordor's rear
If the Alliance wins, the scenario transitions to the Siege of Barad-dûr

victory_conditions.alliance: Push all enemy forces behind the Black Gates
victory_conditions.mordor: Eliminate Elendil and Gil-galad OR destroy 10 Alliance units

scenarios.name: The Siege of Minas Tirith
scenarios.description: Mordor's forces lay siege to the White City. The Witch-king leads the assault from the air, while trolls and orcs batter the gates. Inside, Denethor descends into madness and Faramir leads the defense.
scenarios.map: Minas Tirith fortress station — the seven circles

objective.gondor: Defend Minas Tirith for 6 rounds until reinforcements arrive. Protect the White Tree.
objective.mordor: Breach the gates and capture the White Tower before reinforcements arrive.

gondor_forces: Faramir (commander — Captain of the White Tower)
Gandalf the White (arrives at round 1 — rallies the defense)
The White Tree (objective — must be protected)
mordor_forces: Witch-king of Angmar on Fell Beast (air unit — terror)
The Ram (siege weapon — targets the gates)

special_rules: The seven circles: each circle provides layered defense
The Ram: Mordor's primary weapon against the gates; must be destroyed
The Witch-king's terror: Gondor units within range suffer -1 morale
Denethor's madness: at round 4, Denethor may sabotage the defense
Gandalf's rallying: can restore morale and activate hidden reserves
Reinforcements: Aragorn arrives at round 6 with the Army of the Dead
The White Tree: if captured, Gondor suffers severe penalties

victory_conditions.gondor: Survive 6 rounds with the White Tower intact
victory_conditions.mordor: Capture the White Tower OR kill Faramir and Gandalf before round 6

scenarios.name: The Confrontation at the Argonath
scenarios.description: Aragorn reveals himself to Sauron by using the Palantír, then sails past the Argonath with the Army of the Dead. A dramatic space race and confrontation as Aragorn draws Sauron's forces to the Black Gates.
scenarios.map: The Anduin corridor — from the Argonath to the Black Gates

factions.player_1: Aragorn and the Army of the Dead

objective.aragorn: Reach the Black Gates and feint an attack, drawing Sauron's forces away from Mordor's interior.
objective.mordor: Intercept and destroy Aragorn's fleet before it reaches the Black Gates.

aragorn_forces: Army of the Dead (ghost ships — immune to conventional weapons)
Gondor War Ships: 4 units (reinforcements from the South)
mordor_forces: The Eye of Sauron (surveillance — initially deceived by Aragorn)

special_rules: The Argonath: Aragorn's King's Call — the statues roar, intimidating enemies
Army of the Dead: ghost ships that cannot be harmed by conventional weapons
Palantír deception: Aragorn initially hides his true strength from Sauron
The feint: Aragorn's goal is to draw forces, not win a battle
Oathbreakers: the Dead cannot be killed but can be released from their oath
Sauron's realization: when Sauron sees Aragorn, he commits his forces to the Black Gates

victory_conditions.aragorn: Reach the Black Gates and hold position for 2 rounds (drawing Sauron's forces)
victory_conditions.mordor: Destroy Aragorn's fleet OR prevent him from reaching the Black Gates
